subject.title: fix(codex): require explicit final source delivery

question: Should confirmed Codex `message_tool_only` source delivery remain implicitly terminal with prompt steering, or permanently require `final=true` before OpenClaw treats it as completed?
rationale: Upstream Codex transports dynamic-tool schemas and JSON arguments but provides no source-delivery completion primitive; omission semantics and any public plugin SDK helper are therefore OpenClaw-owned product and compatibility contracts.

options.title: Require explicit final
options.body: Adopt the structural contract on a current-main descendant, limited to Codex message-tool-only source replies, with omission, routing, fallback, and live proof.

options.title: Keep implicit completion
options.body: Select the prompt-only candidate and preserve confirmed-delivery termination, accepting residual early-termination risk when model instructions are ignored.

options.title: Pause both implementations
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and pause the competing branches until maintainers define a different completion API.

recommendation.title: Require explicit final
recommendation.body: Adopt the structural contract on a current-main descendant, limited to Codex message-tool-only source replies, with omission, routing, fallback, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current confirmed-delivery terminal behavior whose permanent semantics now require calibration.
